name: @sublay/monorepo
author: Sublay, maintained by Yanay Tsabary
description: Sublay: Build interactive apps with social features like comments, votes, feeds, user lists, notifications, and more.

scripts.react:build-all: pnpm --filter @sublay/core run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/react-js run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/react-native run build && pnpm --filter @sublay/expo run build
scripts.react:publish-prod: node .github/scripts/check-publish-target.mjs --channel prod --group react && pnpm react:build-all && pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native --filter @sublay/expo run test && SUBLAY_PUBLISH_CHANNEL=prod pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/expo --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native publish --no-git-checks
scripts.react:publish-beta: node .github/scripts/check-publish-target.mjs --channel beta --group react && pnpm react:build-all && pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native --filter @sublay/expo run test && SUBLAY_PUBLISH_CHANNEL=beta pnpm --filter @sublay/core --filter @sublay/expo --filter @sublay/react-js --filter @sublay/react-native publish --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.react:publish-prod:patch: node .github/scripts/check-publish-target.mjs --channel prod --group react && pnpm react:version:patch && SUBLAY_PUBLISH_FRESHNESS_CHECKED=1 pnpm react:publish-prod
scripts.react:publish-prod:minor: node .github/scripts/check-publish-target.mjs --channel prod --group react && pnpm react:version:minor && SUBLAY_PUBLISH_FRESHNESS_CHECKED=1 pnpm react:publish-prod
